primary_user_target: Team throughput and observable queue pressure
reference_role: Longer public-history methodological check; no empirical transfer to the user's young repositories
study_frame: Last 78 complete Monday-start UTC weeks ending at the latest boundary supported by the conservative source cutoff
candidate: Empirical distribution of eight preceding complete portfolio weeks
primary_comparator: Expanding empirical distribution from the same study-frame start
additional_comparators: Poisson distribution using four preceding complete weeks
primary_score: Discrete RPS, equivalently empirical CRPS on integer counts
secondary_score: MAE of predictive median; mean is reported separately as expected count
selection_policy: Do not select or tune operational window using heldout outcomes; publish adverse and null results
superiority_rule: At least five percent mean RPS reduction against frozen expanding comparator plus positive lower uncertainty bound with adequate independent temporal blocks; otherwise exploratory/inconclusive
operational_daily_amendment: Young repositories may issue a separately labelled one-day empirical forecast from four to eight complete UTC days; do not scale/convolve into a weekly forecast or claim skill from sparse launch data
training_cut: Minimum latest selected collection started_at, distinct from forecast issued_at; no invented zero bins after last observed inventory
weekly_and_fortnight_cold_start: Unavailable below four complete weeks/eight complete weeks respectively
